snippet.title: SURA : Shattered Star | PV trailer
snippet.description:
Renowned space mercenary Sura takes on what appears to be a routine pirate elimination contract.

Deep within an abandoned space station, however, she discovers traces of secret experiments and countless victims concealed by a powerful corporation.

SURA: Shattered Star is a stylish 2D Iaido action platformer set in a space opera universe.

Exploit enemy openings, cut them down with lightning-fast strikes, and maintain the flow of combat by alternating between drawing and sheathing your blade. Overcome walls and hazardous terrain, defeat powerful bosses, and uncover the truth hidden within the depths of the sealed space station.
